class.name: RootMotionLayeredMove
class.brief_description: Motion driven by an animation, laid over whatever movement mode is running.
class.description: This is the whole of root motion, and it is a [LayeredMove] rather than new machinery - which is the point the propose/execute split was making. The animation proposes a velocity; the active [MovementMode] still does the sweeping, the collision and the floor. A root-motion attack therefore cannot walk through a wall or off a ledge, and needed no special case anywhere to stop it. Defaults to [constant ProposedMove.OVERRIDE_ALL_EXCEPT_VERTICAL] and an unlimited duration: the animation drives horizontal movement, gravity still applies, and whatever started the animation cancels the move when it ends. Two things have to be right on the [AnimationMixer] or it silently proposes nothing: - [member AnimationMixer.callback_mode_process] must be the physics one. Root motion is consumed per simulated tick, and a mixer advancing on the render frame hands out deltas that do not line up with it. - [member AnimationMixer.root_motion_track] is the [b]track's own path[/b] - for a [Node3D] position track that is just the node, [code]"Root"[/code], not [code]"Root:position"[/code]. A skeleton track is [code]"Skeleton3D:Hips"[/code]. Rotation is not consumed yet: [method AnimationMixer.get_root_motion_rotation] is available but nothing applies [member ProposedMove.angular_velocity_deg]. Works on [CharacterMovementComponent2D] too, with one thing to know first: Godot accumulates root motion only from [constant Animation.TYPE_POSITION_3D] tracks, and a 2D position track contributes nothing at all. A 2D pawn therefore needs a plain [Node3D] hung under it as the carrier for the track to address. That is legal, and the node is never actually moved - a root motion track is excluded from being applied, in either dimension. The x and y of the delta are then pixels. The delta is taken as authored in 2D rather than turned by the character's facing, because a 2D [MovementState] carries no rotation: facing there is a sprite flip, not a transform the solver knows about. An animation that has to run both ways either flips sign in the track or is authored twice.

method.description: The [AnimationMixer] this move reads, once resolved.

method.name: set_mixer
method.description: Sets the mixer directly, instead of letting [member animation_mixer_path] find it.

members.member: Where to find the [AnimationMixer], relative to the pawn's root - the node the movement component drives. Resolved once, when the move starts.
